description.value:
Trigger Strike after moving at least 10 feet in a straight line

Damage +1d6

Type Passive

On a hit, you can also attempt to knock the target prone or push it 5 feet.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 5 -- no roll-option exists for "moved at least 10 feet in a straight line this turn" (pf2e's real movement-triggered feats are built as their own action macros, not generic predicates); DamageDice (a real key) could add the bonus die if such a predicate existed, but it doesn't.
